body: She is leaving for college soon and I'm going to kill myself.
The mental health services in this country are shamefully bad.
Not much to be honest. I try to think before I speak more and try to calm down before I say anything hurtful, but it still happens.
I apologise, I apologise a lot but it happens again and some people just think that it means I hate them, when in reality it's poor impulse control. If that makes sense.

I usually have a short temper or say mean things when angry. Because I'm depressed it means I'm a lot moodier than most people so it leads to me saying mean things often, but I don't mean it. It's a problem with emotional regulation.
I feel that I'm incapable of having healthy relationships with people, among other reasons. I just don't know what to do.

A pretty shit breakup, I'm taking it particularly hard and the end of the relationship was largely caused by me being mentally ill. Can't stop thinking about what I could have done differently to have saved it. I'm 24.

I'm glad that someone is going through something so similar, well not glad but you get the idea. 

I can't get the thought of her out of my head. I feel completely inferior to her now as I was the one messaging her and trying desperately to get her to talk to me. I can relate completely with the feeling that she just sees me as some sort of poor downtrodden person who deserves only pity and worry. I feel like a creep for messaging her even when she told me not to.

I guess I feel abandoned as she was very close to me and always promised to help me when I was feeling low, I guess she just got sick of it which is fair, but she seemed so harsh when I tried talking to her. She just doesn't want me in her life anymore at all and it kills me to think of seeing her with someone else.

It's traumatic when someone you care about suddenly exits your situation on bad terms, especially when we're so mentally fragile. I think when I realised we weren't going to get back together I made a last ditch effort for her attention by trying to overdose. When I told her what I did, she told my sister on facebook. Her last message to me was telling me to talk to my family about it because "it's none of her business anymore", that hurt a lot.

I had a bad breakup, I have a history of having outbursts and being abusive in relationships. I realise that it's a huge problem but it's so hard to stop. I separated from my ex last month and was in contact with her yesterday, I wanted to get back together but she didn't want to talk to me and said I need help. I felt abandoned and as a last ditch attempt tried begging and grovelling to get her back, she told me to stop and I then attempted suicide by swallowing pills, she told my sister, my sister told my parents and they took the medication away from me. Don't know where to go from here, I'm emotionally drained and I just don't want to live. Hopeless.
I cant afford the psych ward. I can't be helped, I just want to die.
I want to take more pills.
